description: Human-reviewed highest validated upstream agent version per hook connector x OS. The live connector E2E workflow (.github/workflows/connector-live-e2e.yml) only REPORTS the version it ran against and opens a connector-regression issue on a live-cell failure — it never edits this file. A maintainer updates last_validated_version here (and, when raising/lowering a support floor/ceiling, hook_contracts.json + internal/gateway/connector/hook_contract.go) after reviewing a green run. 'os' keys are linux, macos, windows; an empty last_validated_version means 'not yet certified'.

copilot.notes: Native Windows setup is supported. Authentication, HITL, and official-client live evidence remain unverified and unclaimed; Windows validation version/date/run fields remain empty and live=false.

hermes.notes: contract-only (Layer A); the identical exact 23-event shell-hook set and pre_tool_call response semantics were source-verified at official Hermes Agent tags v2026.7.20 (0.19.0), v2026.7.30 (0.19.1), and v2026.8.3 (0.20.0), bounded to <0.21.0. Packaged and real-client Windows validation remains pending.

windsurf.notes: Supported legacy Cascade-only contract (Layer A). Devin Local (the current default), its separate lifecycle hooks, cloud, ACP, and managed/ProgramData layers are unsupported and unverified; no real-client evidence is recorded and live=false.

opencode.notes: Source-reviewed contract is pinned to OpenCode 1.18.11 (reviewed range >=1.18.10,<1.18.12); the relevant 1.18.11 plugin/runtime files are byte-identical to 1.18.10. Native Windows setup is supported, while authentic official-client validation metadata remains empty and live=false.

antigravity.notes: Native Windows x64 setup is supported. The accepted protected harness pins official CLI 1.1.10 as availability metadata only, not as a validation record. No protected-client, authentication, HITL, client-provenance, or official-client live evidence is claimed; validation version/date/run fields remain empty and live=false. Enterprise/managed, Team, ProgramData, cloud-dashboard, MDM, and organization-policy surfaces remain out of scope and unverified. Real official-client E2E requires a dedicated pre-authenticated Windows runner because Google documents Windows Credential Manager/browser auth, not API-key bootstrap.

amp.notes: plugin contract validated against Amp 0.0.1785334225; live policy-cell certification pending

omnigent.notes: contract-only; the supported native Windows server/SDK policy bridge and required CI remain native-degraded; live=false, authentic live and authentication/HITL evidence remain pending and unclaimed, and the CI gate does not add a public Setup availability gate
